# Nostalgex

> Nostalgex is a free, open source (MIT) app that turns your own Plex, Jellyfin or Emby media library into 130+ live TV channels in 14 bundles, with a retro channel guide. It runs natively on Apple TV (tvOS 18 or later) and in a web browser through the free web tuner. It needs no paid service and nothing installed on your media server. It does not host or supply any media; everything plays from your own server.

Nostalgex is made by Chad Mueller (Muell Haus Inc.). It is not affiliated with Plex, Jellyfin, Emby or Apple, and it is a different product from NostalgiaTV.

## Get it

- [Nostalgex on the App Store (Apple TV)](https://apps.apple.com/app/nostalgex/id6762563534): free, tvOS 18 or later
- [Nostalgex for Apple TV](https://www.nostalgex.app/apple-tv): what the Apple TV app does, how sign-in works for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby, and how it compares to Pseudo TV, Tunarr and ErsatzTV
- [Web tuner](https://www.nostalgex.app/web-tuner): free, runs in a browser; Jellyfin and Emby need an https address, Plex works as is
- [Self-host the web tuner](https://www.nostalgex.app/self-host): the same tuner as a Docker container on your own machine, over plain http on your network, so a Jellyfin or Emby server with no https address is reachable from a browser

## Server guides

- [Nostalgex for Plex](https://www.nostalgex.app/plex): sign in with a code at plex.tv/link
- [Nostalgex for Jellyfin](https://www.nostalgex.app/jellyfin): Quick Connect or username and password
- [Nostalgex for Emby](https://www.nostalgex.app/emby): username and password, on Apple TV and on the web tuner

## Channels

- [Channel Guide](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels): all 142 channels in 14 bundles

### Bundles

- [Nostalgex](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/nostalgex): The 80s and 90s. All retro, all the time (22 channels)
- [Kidz Zone](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/kids): Disney, Nickelodeon, Pixar, and more (15 channels)
- [Prime Time](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/essentials): Everyday favorites and feel good viewing (16 channels)
- [Marquee](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/premium): Premium channels (11 channels)
- [Adventureland](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/adventureland): Epic quests, disasters, and adrenaline (9 channels)
- [Overtime](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/sports): Movies, shows, and docs (3 channels)
- [Case Files](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/truecrime): True crime, thrillers & mystery (6 channels)
- [Decades](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/decades): Movies and shows sorted by decade (7 channels)
- [Franchises](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/franchises): Movie franchise marathons (7 channels)
- [Arthouse](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/arthouse): Criterion, foreign films, midnight movies, and cult classics (4 channels)
- [Networks](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/streamers): Channels by streaming service and studio (12 channels)
- [Scream](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/seasonal): Horror, all year's worth, front and centre every October (8 channels)
- [Tis the Season](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/tis-the-season): Christmas, Thanksgiving and holiday channels (8 channels)
- [High Rotation](https://www.nostalgex.app/channels/high-rotation): Music videos by genre (14 channels)
